categories.title: When the day feels heavy
messages: Har din ko perfect hona zaroori nahi hai. Aap apne pace par chalte ho, wahi sabse bada proof hai.
Aaj agar sab kuch thoda cloudy lag raha hai, toh aap apne liye thoda waqt nikaal sakte ho.
Aapko sab kuch ek saath theek karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas ek deep breath lijiye aur aaram karte ho.
Aap jaise sochte ho aur jaise sambhalte ho, bohot pyare aur strong lagte ho.

categories.title: When you need a small break
messages: Ek cup garam chai, thodi si shanti aur apne liye kuch minutes. Aap aaram se waqt bitate ho.
Phone ko thodi der side mein rakh kar khidki ke paas baithiye. Baarish ki awaaz sunte ho.
Aap thoda stretch karte ho, paani peete ho, aur bina kisi guilt ke rest karte ho.

categories.title: When you feel overwhelmed
messages: Duniya ka saara bojh aapke kandhon par nahi hai. Aap ek samay par bas ek hi chhota kadam uthate ho.
Agar koi baat pareshaan kare, toh thodi der usse door hokar saans lijiye. Sab theek ho jayega.
Aapki feelings bilkul valid hain. Aap khud par bilkul sakht nahi bante ho.

categories.title: When you want something comforting
messages: Yeh chhota sa corner hamesha aapke liye yahin hai. Aap jab bhi chahein yahan aate ho.
Aap jab muskuraate ho, sabse pyare lagte ho. Par jab mann na ho, tab bhi aap utne hi precious ho.
Warm chai, halki baarish, aur aapka yeh chhota sa space jahan aap sukoon paate ho.

categories.title: When you need a reminder to rest
categories.hindiTitle: Aaram karne ki chhoti si yaad
messages: Aapko har waqt productive rehna zaroori nahi hai. Rest bhi utna hi important hota hai.
Aapki neend aur aapka sukoon sabse pehle aana chahiye. Aap bina kisi fikar ke so sakte ho.
Aaj ke din aapne bohot achha kiya. Ab aap aaram se rest karte ho.

categories.title: When you want a tiny smile
categories.hindiTitle: Ek pyari si muskaan ke liye
messages: Aapki chhoti chhoti baatein aur expressions kitne cute hote hain! Aap jab haste ho sab theek lagta hai.
Chhoti si progress bhi real progress hoti hai. Aap bohot pyare lagte ho.
Aapka Sir jiii hamesha aapke sukoon aur muskaan ki wish karta hai.

categories.title: When you want to feel appreciated
messages: The way you see things from your own point of view is truly special. Aap alag sochte ho.
Aap jab bolte ho aur presence dete ho, aas-paas ka mahaul kitna calm aur achha ho jaata hai.
Aapki individuality hi aapki sabse badi khoobsurti hai. Aap jaise ho, waise hi pyare lagte ho.

notes.title: Chhoti si baat yaad rakhne ke liye
notes.body: Aapko hamesha sab kuch pehle se tay karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Aap jis dhang se sab handle karte ho, woh bohot khoobsurat hai.

notes.title: Day 5 Period Care Reminder 🌸
notes.body: Aaj periods ka 5th day hai. Thoda pet aur peeth mein dard ya thakan ho sakti hai. Aap garam paani pijiye, blanket lijiye aur aaram karte ho.

notes.title: Cloudy days are gentle days ☁️
notes.body: Baarish ka mausam sab kuch dho kar saaf kar deta hai. Waise hi cloudy days humein thoda rukne aur apni energy wapas paane ka mauka dete hain.

notes.title: Chai aur khamoshi ☕
notes.body: Shaam ko cup pakad kar baithna, bina kisi jaldbaazi ke, sabse bada sukoon hota hai jo aap khud ko dete ho.

notes.title: Aapka Masoom Gussa 😾
notes.body: Aap jab thoda naak chadhate ho ya chhotu sa gussa karte ho na, lagta hai duniya ki saari cuteness ek jagah ikatthi ho gayi hai!

notes.title: Cramps Relief Protocol 🕯️
notes.body: Heat pad ko pet par rakhiye, pairon ke niche soft pillow lagaiye aur ek cup adrak-elaichi chai sip kijiye. Sir jiii is sending healing hugs!

notes.title: No Guilt Rest Day 🧸
notes.body: Aaj agar aapne bistar se uthne ka mann na banaya ho, toh bilkul guilt mat lijiye. Sharir jab heal ho raha ho, toh aaram hi sabse bada kaam hota hai.

notes.title: The Way You Laugh ✨
notes.body: Aap jab khul kar haste ho, toh kamre mein achanak roshni si aa jaati hai. Aapki muskaan bohot precious hai.

notes.title: A Hug From Afar 🫂
notes.body: Aankhein band kijiye aur mehsus kijiye: ek lamba, garam aur safe hug jo aapke saare dard aur thakan ko absorb kar raha hai.

notes.title: Sweet Cravings Allowed 🍫
notes.body: Chocolates, pastries, ya jo bhi meetha khane ka mann ho, bindass khaiye. Period hormones need sweet dopamine!

notes.title: Aapki Khoobsurat Aatma 🌸
notes.body: Aap jaise logon ki parvah karte ho aur dil se baatein bolte ho, waisa koi nahi kar sakta. Aap bohot special lagte ho.

notes.title: Baarish Ki Khidki 🌧️
notes.body: Boondon ko kaanch par fisalte dekhna aur sochna ki life mein bhi har toofan ke baad aisi hi thandak aati hai.

notes.title: Day 6 Pe Dheere Dheere Glow 🕊️
notes.body: Day 5 ke baad dard ka aakhri pehra chala jaata hai. Kal se aap bilkul fresh feel karenge, Beendani ji!

notes.title: Sir jiii Ka Constant Vaada 💍
notes.body: Chahe aap bohot khush ho ya bohot pareshaan, aapka Sir jiii hamesha aapke paas rahega. Never ever doubt that.

notes.title: Sip Some Water 💧
notes.body: Hydration period bloating ko 50% kam kar deta hai. Gunguna paani peete rahiye aur deep breaths lete ho.

notes.title: You Are Doing Great 💜
notes.body: Aapne itne dino ka dard aur mood shifts akele jhele hain. You are so strong, my Diyuuuu. I am so proud of you.

letters.title: A Letter for Your Cloudy Days
letters.body:
Aap jab bhi yeh letter padhte ho, chahe din kaisa bhi raha ho, I hope yeh chhota sa corner aapko thoda sukoon aur warmth de sake.

Yeh website maine isliye banayi taaki aapke paas hamesha ek aisi jagah ho jahan koi shor na ho, koi expectation na ho, aur na hi koi pressure ho. Jab baahar cloudy lage ya sharir thoda thaka hua ho (khaaskar in dino), toh aap yahan aakar baarish ki awaaz sunte ho, soft music chalate ho, ya bas shaant pal bitate ho.

Aap jaise ho, bohot genuine aur special lagte ho. Har din perfect nahi hota, par aapka sukoon hamesha zaroori hai.

Aap jab chahein, apne pace par explore karte ho. Yeh chhota sa world hamesha yahin rahega, aapke liye.
letters.signature:
Always wishing you peace & warm chai,
Nishant (Your Sir jiii)

surpriseEnvelope.hint: Tap gently to unfold the letter inside...
surpriseEnvelope.letterContent:
Dear Diyuuuu,

If you are opening this today, here is a small reminder:

Aapko saara bojh akele uthane ki zaroorat nahi hai. It is completely okay to let go of expectations, put on warm socks, wrap yourself in a blanket, and just be.

Khaaskar aaj jab aapka period ka 5th day hai, aap bas aaram karte ho. Aapka Sir jiii hamesha aapke sukoon aur muskaan ki wish karta hai.

Take care of yourself today. You are cherished! ☁️💜
surpriseEnvelope.signature:
With warm regards,
Nishant Raj (Sir jiii)

surpriseEnvelopes.title: For When You Feel Tired 🌸
surpriseEnvelopes.subtitle: Lavender Seal — Deep Comfort
surpriseEnvelopes.letterContent:
Meri sabse pyari Diyuuuu,

Aap itna sab kuch sambhalte ho aur kabhi complain nahi karte. Lekin aaj aapka 5th day hai period ka, sharir thaka hua hai aur aapko sach mein rest ki zaroorat hai.

Aapko lagta hoga ki sab perfect hona chahiye, par aap mere liye waise hi perfect ho jaise aap sochte ho, bolte ho, aur muskuraate ho. Blanket lapet lijiye, Sir jiii ka diya hua warm hug mehsoos kijiye aur bas thoda aaram karte ho.

Aapki har takleef meri hai. Take it easy today, bbg.

surpriseEnvelopes.title: For When Your Mood Swings 🍫
surpriseEnvelopes.subtitle: Amber Seal — Sweet Reassurance
surpriseEnvelopes.letterContent:
Beendani ji,

Jab periods ke dauraan achanak chidchidahat ho ya rona aaye bina kisi wajah ke, toh yaad rakhna ki yeh bas hormones ki shaitaani hai! Aap bilkul theek ho.

Aap jitna chahein chocolates khate ho, gussa karte ho, nakhre dikhate ho—aapka Sir jiii yahan aapke saare nakhre uthane ke liye ready baitha hai. Aap jab thode gusse mein hote ho na, tab bhi sabse cute lagte ho!

Eat your sweets without guilt!
surpriseEnvelopes.signature:
Always by your side,
Nishant (Sir jiii) 🍯

surpriseEnvelopes.title: For Cramps & Body Ache 🕯️
surpriseEnvelopes.subtitle: Rose Seal — Healing Warmth
surpriseEnvelopes.letterContent:
Meri Babyyyyy,

I know pet mein aur lower back mein jo ajeeb sa heavy pain aur cramps hote hain, woh kitne exhausting hote hain. Kahaash main wahan hota aur aapka sar daba sakta ya heat pad rakh sakta.

Par abhi ke liye, sochiye main aapke bilkul paas hoon, aapka haath thaame hue aur aapko ek tight soft hug de raha hoon. Garam chai pijiye aur aankhein band karke lofi music sunte ho. Dard jaldi theek ho jayega.
surpriseEnvelopes.signature:
With infinite kisses on your forehead,
Nishant Raj 🌸

surpriseEnvelopes.title: For When You Feel Insecure 🌿
surpriseEnvelopes.subtitle: Emerald Seal — Pure Truth
surpriseEnvelopes.letterContent:
Diyuuuu,

Kabhi bhi apne aap par shaq mat karna. Aap jaisi ho, jitni masoom, jitni loyal aur jitni dedicated ho, duniya mein koi aap jaisa nahi hai. Aapki baatein, aapka gussa, aapka hasna sab kuch mere dil ke sabse kareeb hai.

Aap jis tarah har baat ko dil se mehsus karte ho, wahi aapko sabse alag banata hai. You are my pride, my gurllll. Hamesha sar utha kar chalte ho aur khush rehte ho.

surpriseEnvelopes.title: A Promise for the Future ✨
surpriseEnvelopes.subtitle: Gold Seal — Eternal Bond
surpriseEnvelopes.letterContent:
Meri Madam Ji,

Chahe din cloudy ho ya dhoop khili ho, chahe period ka heavy flow ho ya calm peaceful shaam, Nishant hamesha aapke saath khada rahega. Aapko kabhi akele suffer karne ki zaroorat nahi padegi.

Yeh website aapka hamesha ka sanctuary hai. Jab bhi dil ghabraye, yahan aate ho, notes padhte ho, aur yaad rakhte ho ki koi hai jo aapse bohot zyada pyaar aur respect karta hai. You are truly precious to me.

1.summary: Pehle din uterine contractions tez hote hain aur energy zero feel hoti hai.
